_comment: Single source of truth for every generated illustration prompt. tools/recraft.py reads this file; no prompt text exists anywhere else. See assets/prompts/README.md for how to run the pipeline and assets/prompts/recraft.md for the art-direction rationale behind `style`.
style: Mid-century modern screenprint illustration in the lineage of Alexander Girard and Charley Harper. Completely flat shapes with no outlines, no shading, no gradients, and no rendering -- form is carried entirely by silhouette. Visible risograph halftone grain sits inside each flat ink shape and along its edges. The composition sits on a large organic field shape rather than bleeding to the edges, leaving a warm cream margin like a printed plate. Small stippled celestial glyphs -- a circle, a crescent, and a five-pointed star -- float as fine grain texture against the flat ink shapes. Clean and minimal: three or four large shapes at most, no fine detail, no invented alphabet or constructed script, no readable or pseudo-readable lettering of any kind.
